sentences.text:
The Oriental Insurance Co. Ltd vs Bandana Biswas & Ors on 10
July, 2025
10.07.2025
 Ct. No.33
Sl. No. 157 & 158
 cm
 Fma 95 of 2025
 Can 1 of 2024

The Oriental Insurance Co. Ltd.
 Vs.
 Bandana Biswas & Ors.
 With
 Fmat(Mv) 455 of 2024
 Can 1 of 2025

Vs.
 The Oriental Insurance Co. Ltd. & Anr.
 Ms. Sucharita Paul
 ... for the appellant/insurance co.
 Mr. Muktakesh Das
 ... for the respondents/claimants
Fma 95 of 2025 with In Re: Can 1 of 2024

As per the order of this Court dated 19.12.2024 the Insurance Company had deposited the entire awarded compensation before the office of the learned Registrar General, High Court at Calcutta vide OD Challan No. 2841 dated 13.01.2025.
Let the said challan be kept on record.
Accordingly, the interim order of stay dated 19.12.2024 is made absolute and the stay shall continue till the disposal of the instant appeal.

The application being CAN 1 of 2024 is disposed of.
FMAT(MV) 455 of 2024 with In Re: CAN 1 of 2025 The application being CAN 1 of 2025 under Section 5 of the limitation Act has been taken up for hearing.
From the record it reveals that there is a delay of 136 days.
Considering the averments made in Paragraph 3 of the CAN application being 1 of 2025 and in view of the beneficial legislative intent the delay of 136 days in filing the instant case is condoned.
The Department is directed to register the appeal.
Let the matter be fixed on 18 th August, 2025 under the heading "For Orders".
